identity.title: [v0.92.1][Runtime API] Expose canonical agent names in roster and detail responses

values.task_boundary: One additive canonical-name field carried from authoritative agent state through AgentRosterEntry, roster/detail JSON, and OpenAPI.
deliverables: Roster and detail API projection for dynamic agents and Shepherd
Updated Observatory OpenAPI and checked inventory
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: AgentRosterEntry and roster/detail JSON always emit a nonempty canonical two-part agent name in the additive wire field name.
AC-2: Operational id, canonical name, display label, and public role/office remain separate fields with unchanged existing meanings.
AC-3: Dynamic agents carry the validated AgentAdmissionRequest.name unchanged through AgentSample, AgentRuntimeEvidence, roster, and detail responses.
AC-4: Runtime init requires and validates resident_shepherd.name, and the production binary passes it to the Shepherd roster constructor without ID or label inference.
AC-5: Observatory OpenAPI keeps adl.runtime_v3.agent_roster_entry.v1, adds required outbound name, and its checked inventory matches serialized output.

AC-6: Focused tests prove current output always contains name, previously recorded v1 JSON without name remains readable through a deserialization-only default, existing fields retain exact serialization, and zero-test selection fails.
dependencies: Issue #602 and PR #614 must be merged into the execution base
non_goals: Changing agent admission, checkpoint, migration, or rehydration semantics
Amending the already merged #602 implementation outside a correctness defect required for projection
